reviews.title: Doesn’t work on YouTube
reviews.text: This still doesn’t work as advertised on YouTube. Did you enable content blockers in your Safari settings? Did you configure all the settings correctly? Do you realize that this only works in the Safari browser and not the YouTube app? Yes, yes, and yes, don’t patronize us like we’re stupid, although we were dumb enough to pay for this merely intermittently working app. To make matters worse, it’s even quite dangerous. A close associate’s grandmother had this app and since it only seems to work whenever it’s not appropriate, and because not everyone has the time to meticulously whitelist sites to ensure it’s not the discombobulated mess that it is, she was not able to alert her caregivers for help in time and ultimately passed into the next life. Fortunately, she had left this colleague a hefty fortune in inheritance, so they were actually quite satisfied with this app, so it should be noted that YMMV.

I had no idea, or I forgot I was actually paying for this useless app.    I cancelled today for good. Frustrated and I still can’t believe I was paying for the Ad blocker.
